builds_components: Each line names a part in the owner's inventory by id (part_id, not null), and the receiving workspace holds none of those parts: carrying a build's parts needs a line that can name a part the receiver does not have, a design of its own (#6252).
builds_op_qty: Quantities logged against one operation as it ran: the owner's own history.
builds_op_time: Time logged against one operation as it ran: the owner's own history.
builds_operations: A build's steps are run against the owner's machines and parts (operation logs hang off them); carrying them needs the same part-naming design as builds_components (#6252).
builds_planned: What the owner plans to build next, against their own stock: the owner's plan, not a fact about the build.
builds_run_inputs: Part of a run's log (what one run consumed): the owner's own history.
builds_run_outputs: Part of a run's log (what one run produced): the owner's own history.
builds_runs: A log of the owner's own runs of the build: what they did with it, not what they wrote about it.
core_ai_chat_turn_events: The steps of one of the owner's assistant turns: a conversation with the assistant, never a record that is shared.
core_catalogs_entries: Catalog entries are records of their own kind (core-catalogs:entry), which a share cannot hold yet (#5911); a catalog shared as a record carries none of them by design until it can.
core_devices_readings: Readings a device link took in the owner's workshop: live machine data, not what the owner wrote about a record.
core_discussion_comments: A shared record's conversation already travels both ways through the share's own conversation sync (share-spaces.md section 12), as comments, not as rows.
core_discussion_mentions: Who a comment mentioned in the owner's workspace: people of that workspace, meaningless on the other side.
core_discussion_reads: Who has read a conversation: each person's own read marks.
core_files_attachments: A record's attached files already travel with it, file by file (share-mirror.ts carryFiles, #6056).
core_import_run_steps: The steps of one import run: the owner's own job history.
core_integrations_pace: When an outside connection may next send: the owner's own connection bookkeeping, never shared.
core_integrations_sync_state: Where an outside connection's sync has reached: the owner's own connection, never shared.
core_integrations_synced_records: Which records an outside connection made: the owner's own connection bookkeeping.
core_locations_plan_drafts: An unsaved layout draft the owner is editing: work in progress, not the place itself.
core_public_surfaces_label_scans: Scans of a public page's labels: visitors' traffic, not what the owner wrote about a record.
core_public_surfaces_views: Views of a public page: visitors' traffic.
core_scan_item_revisions: The edit history of one scan inbox row: the owner's own intake, never shared.
core_scan_qr_rule_tallies: How often a resolver rule matched in this workspace's own scans: a count of the owner's scanning, not what they wrote about the rule.
core_services_job_files: Files one service job used or made: the owner's own job.
core_tags_assignments: Which records carry a tag in the owner's workspace: tags are the owner's own vocabulary, shared as values on a record, not as this table.
digifab_arm_approvals: A person's approval at the cell to start one program revision with the owner's tooling on the owner's arm: it authorizes physical work there and must never travel to another workspace.
digifab_arm_copies: A copy of one of the owner's arm programs onto another of their arms, with its re-teach checklist: work in the owner's own cell on their own machines, not what they wrote about the program.
digifab_cell_steps: The steps one of the owner's cell jobs ran in their own workshop: live machine history, not what the owner wrote about a record.
digifab_jobs: Jobs sent to the owner's own machines through a connection: the owner's equipment and history.
digifab_laser_sheet_claims: Sheets a laser plan has claimed from the owner's stock: the owner's own use.
digifab_make_steps: Steps the owner's machines ran for one make: production history.
digifab_pool_members: Which of the owner's machines are in a pool: the owner's equipment.
digifab_print_rule_state: Where one automation rule has reached: the owner's own automation.
digifab_print_rules: Automation rules on one of the owner's channels: the owner's own automation.
digifab_printer_links: Which printers a connection reaches: the owner's own equipment.
digifab_production_runs: Production runs on one of the owner's machine pools: production history.
digifab_resin_prints: What one resin job printed: the owner's own production history.
inventory_allocations: Stock the owner set aside for something: the owner's own use of the part.
inventory_consumption: Stock the owner used up: the owner's own history of the part.
inventory_paste_storage: How the owner keeps one part's paste: the owner's own storage.
inventory_recount_scans: The scans of one of the owner's stock recounts: a count log of what the owner's hands found at one moment, their own history, not what they wrote about a record.
inventory_sheet_area: What is left of one sheet in the owner's stock: the owner's own stock.
inventory_stock: How much of the part the owner holds: their own stock, and a share's copy keeps its own count.
inventory_stock_loaded: Stock loaded into the owner's machines: the owner's own use.
inventory_stock_operations: Operation IDs already applied to the owner's stock: local duplicate protection, not facts about a shared part.
inventory_stock_storage: Where the owner keeps the part's stock: the owner's own places (a share carries places only when the owner turns that on, as the record's place).
inventory_stock_uses: The log of the owner's uses of the part: their own history.
labels_prints: Labels printed in one of the owner's print batches: the owner's own printing.
lists_items: A list's items are records of their own kind (lists:item): a list's things are shared as records, not as rows of the list.
lists_source_last_list: Which list a source last added to: the owner's own shortcut.
projects_pattern_reads: How the pattern's file was read: worked out again from the same file, which the copy has, on the receiving side.
projects_pattern_texts: The text read out of the pattern's file: worked out again from the same file on the receiving side.
projects_task_dependencies: Which tasks wait on which: tasks are records of their own kind (projects:task), shared as records.
purchases_arrival_asks: Questions the owner's intake asked about an order's arrival: the owner's own intake.
purchases_order_items: An order's lines are records of their own kind (purchases:order_item), which a share cannot hold yet (#5911).
purchases_order_pages: The order's pages as the owner's intake read them: the owner's own paperwork.
purchases_order_shipments: Shipments the owner's tracking follows for an order: the owner's own tracking.
purchases_receive_outbox: Delivery attempts for the owner's stock and spend wires: operational state that must never replay in a receiving workspace.
purchases_returns: Returns the owner made against an order: the owner's own dealings.
sales_holds: What stock a draft order holds for its customer: the owner's own bookkeeping, never carried when the order is shared.
sales_order_documents: The shop's numbered financial paperwork includes its customer's address. It stays with the shop when an order is shared; the owner distributes the PDF explicitly through download or email.
sales_order_history: The history of one of the owner's sales: their own dealings.
sales_order_items: A sale's lines are records of their own kind (sales:order_item), which a share cannot hold yet (#5911).
sales_payments: What a customer paid the owner on a sale: the owner's own accounting, never carried when the order is shared.
sales_returns: What the owner took back and refunded on a sale: the owner's own accounting, never carried when the order is shared.
sales_stock_draws: Receipts for stock removed from this workspace: local recovery bookkeeping, never shared. Replaying them in another workspace would move its stock for the owner's sale.
tracking_measurements: Measurements are records of their own kind (tracking:measurement), which a share cannot hold yet (#5911).
